description: This is a PHP unit test class for the ZendeskHelpProcessor, specifically testing methods such as retrieving help configuration, generating URLs, and handling HTTP responses. It uses mock handlers to simulate HTTP interactions with the Zendesk API.

classes.name: ZendeskHelpProcessorTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class extending KernelTestCase, designed to test the functionality of ZendeskHelpProcessor, including URL construction, HTTP interactions, and fallback behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of ZendeskHelpProcessor and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetHelpConfigService
methods.description: Verifies that getHelpConfigService returns an instance of HelpConfigService.

methods.name: testGetHttpClient
methods.description: Checks that getHttpClient returns an instance of GuzzleHttp Client.

methods.name: testGetBaseUrl
methods.description: Confirms getBaseUrl returns the expected Zendesk URL.

methods.name: testGetSearchUrl
methods.description: Asserts getSearchUrl constructs the correct search API endpoint URL with label filters.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl
methods.description: Tests getRedirectUrl retrieves the appropriate article URL given a label, mocking a successful API response.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl2
methods.description: Tests getRedirectUrl returns the default URL when API responses are empty.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl3
methods.description: Ensures getRedirectUrl falls back to the default URL when an HTTP exception occurs.

methods.name: testGetDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Validates that getDefaultRedirectUrl returns the standard fallback URL.
